title: BankConnectionsResourceTransaction
description: A Transaction represents a real transaction that affects a Financial Connections Account balance.

account.description: The ID of the Financial Connections Account this transaction belongs to.

amount.description: The amount of this transaction, in cents (or local equivalent).

currency.description: Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

transacted_at.description: Time at which the transaction was transacted. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

transaction_refresh.description: The token of the transaction refresh that last updated or created this transaction.

updated.description: Time at which the object was last updated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
